title: Top Habits of Wealthy People

scenes.fact: A study shows that nearly 60% of millionaires don't use a formal budget. This contradicts common belief.
scenes.text: Only 40% of millionaires keep a budget!
Wealthy individuals prioritize investing over saving. They allocate about 15% of income to investments.
Budgeting isn’t the norm for wealth!
Follow and your future rich self will thank you.

description: The habits wealthy people avoid might surprise you! Follow us for more insights on money management.
